title: Presentation Slides
tagline: Transform unstructured briefs into presentation structures, speaker notes, and narratives

cases.title: Seed-Round Pitch Deck Narrative (10 Slides)
cases.description: Craft Sequoia-style pitch deck outline with problem statement, secret sauce, business model, and ask.
cases.prompt: Generate a 10-slide venture pitch deck outline for an enterprise local-first AI engine, including slide titles, visual layout, and key bullets.
cases.sample_output:
## Slide 1: Title & Hook
- **Headline:** The Local-First Sovereign AI Engine
- **Visual:** Minimal dark theme with glowing local node network
- **Speaker Notes:** Introduce the massive enterprise shift from cloud API leaks to zero-trust on-prem compute.

cases.title: Quarterly Business Review (QBR)
cases.description: Structure an executive review slide deck highlighting OKRs, financial milestones, and strategic bets.
cases.prompt: Draft a 6-slide QBR presentation reviewing product engineering velocity, cost reduction achievements, and next quarter OKRs.
cases.sample_output: QBR presentation structure generated with 6 slides, data tables for sprint velocity, and bulleted strategic priorities.

cases.title: System Architecture Deep-Dive Deck
cases.description: Technical slide walkthrough detailing microservices, IPC message protocols, and failover mechanics.
cases.prompt: Outline a technical architecture presentation for staff engineers explaining our Rust/Tauri IPC protocol and local sidecar supervision.
cases.sample_output: Technical slide deck outline generated with clear diagrams, IPC protocol sequencing, and security boundary guarantees.

cases.title: Developer Conference Keynote
cases.description: Engaging, high-impact keynote narrative with live demo cues and audience takeaway hooks.
cases.prompt: Write a 15-minute developer conference keynote structure on 'The Death of Dumb Cloud APIs: Why Local-First AI Wins'.
cases.sample_output: Keynote script generated with timing marks, punchy opening hook, live terminal demo cues, and memorable conclusion.
